description: The agent must: (1) Read SKILL.md to discover the exact chapter structure, subsection titles in Chinese, and file path conventions. (2) Create `references/exercises.md` covering all 6 subsections of Chapter 1 (分苹果, 搭一搭（一）, 搭一搭（二）, 分草莓, 分橘子, 分一分), using correct terminology (被除数/除数/商 for section 1.5) and including actual arithmetic questions. (3) Create `references/common_errors.md` covering Chapter 4's two subsections (4.1 铅笔有多长 with 厘米/分米, and 4.2 1千米有多长 with 千米), with substantive error descriptions. (4) Create `assets/templates/week_plan.md` targeting Chapter 3 (生活中的大数), listing all 4 correct subsection titles (数一数, 拨一拨, 比一比, 有多少个字), a 5-day weekday structure, the SKILL.md-specified '30-40分钟' daily study time, and a 练习课 day. An agent without SKILL.md would not know the exact Chinese subsection names (e.g., 有多少个字 vs 估一估), the 30-40 minute time spec, the page-accurate chapter ordering, or the precise terminology 被除数/除数/商 as unique to section 1.5.
